lighting.method: static light estimate (delvec prefab, the compiler's block+sky flood): min over 247 floor cell(s) reachable on foot from 7 ground-level entry cell(s), of 247 standable in the region box; every space this piece's spatial contract declares is `enclosed`, so no sky reaches it and the figure is its own block light. Taken at effective sky 0, which is the sky at every hour here, so there is no second and brighter figure to state. NOT a live-server probe; dark_threshold=3. Re-probe live for borderline pieces.
